decks.notes: The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to flood the board with aggressive creatures and take advantage of powerful synergies between cards such as Guide of Souls and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to control the opponent's board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional value and consistency to the deck. Overall, the focus is on overwhelming the opponent with a fast and relentless attack strategy while maintaining some control over the battlefield.

The deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and generate mana quickly, enabling the player to ramp into powerful threats like Primeval Titan. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to search for key artifacts like Amulet of Vigor or Primeval Titan. It aims to assemble a strong board presence quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of land-based ramp and powerful creatures. The inclusion of cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Cultivator Colossus further enhances the deck's ability to ramp and generate mana efficiently.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Lightning Bolt to apply early pressure. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to close out games quickly. With a mix of efficient creatures and removal spells, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional value and flexibility to the deck, allowing for a wide range of versatile plays.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and direct damage spells. The key strategy involves utilizing cards like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride to apply early pressure, while using Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to control the board and take down threats. Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury can quickly close out a game if left unchecked, and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional support for your aggressive creatures. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Static Prison and Goblin Bombardment to hinder your opponent's game plan.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays, using a combination of powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Guide of Souls to quickly overrun the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Static Prison to control the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility and consistency to the deck. Overall, this deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain board control to secure a victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly and aggressively building a board presence with efficient and resilient creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls. The key strategy is to utilize cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to deal massive damage to the opponent while utilizing control elements like Static Prison and Thraben Charm to disrupt their game plan. The deck also includes versatile removal options like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to remove threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, consistent damage while maintaining board control.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Ajanl, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, the deck aims to push for early damage and maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of key support cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison helps to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's overall strategy revolves around quickly building a threatening board presence and finishing off the opponent with direct damage spells.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and card advantage. By controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to stabilize and then take control of the game with powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Graveyard Trespasser. The inclusion of cards like Thought Scour and Fatal Push allows for efficient deck filtering and removal, while the abundance of blue mana sources ensures that the deck can consistently cast its powerful counter spells to maintain control of the game.

This deck focuses on quickly building up +1/+1 counters on creatures using Hardened Scales and Agatha's Soul Cauldron, while also utilizing support cards like Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp and The Ozolith to maximize the value of those counters. With a mix of modular creatures like Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista, along with powerful artifacts and land synergies, this aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a swarm of buffed creatures and versatile threats. The inclusion of control elements like Pithing Needle and Soul-Guide Lantern helps to disrupt opponent strategies and maintain board dominance.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressively playing creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to deal damage quickly. The deck also includes control elements like Static Prison to restrict the opponent's actions. By utilizing cards that boost or protect your creatures like Galvanic Discharge and Guide of Souls, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful offense. The inclusion of cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Goblin Bombardment adds additional threat and versatility to keep the pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on aggressive strategy and utilizing companion Jegantha for additional value. It includes a mix of creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Amped Raptor, along with support cards like Arena of Glory and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also features powerful enchantments like Dreams of Steel and Oil and The One Ring. The mana base consists of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent casting of spells. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent quickly and efficiently while utilizing the deck's synergies and unique cards.

The deck focuses on using a combination of counterspells, bounce effects, and card draw to protect and assemble the combo pieces, ultimately aiming to win the game using the Goblin Charbelcher card. The strategy is to generate a large amount of mana to activate Charbelcher's ability and deal lethal damage to the opponent in one shot. The deck has a landless theme, relying on mana rocks, Lotus Bloom, and Whir of Invention to ramp and find the necessary pieces to execute the combo efficiently.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan by countering spells, removing threats, and disrupting their hand with discard effects. The deck also utilizes graveyard interaction and card advantage to stay ahead in the game. By combining efficient removal spells, counterspells, and card draw, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent until it can secure a win condition, such as through a powerful threat like Graveyard Trespasser or Abhorrent Oculus.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful spells. By playing efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls, alongside support cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and control the battlefield. Cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional threats and finishers to close out the game. The deck also includes some utility cards like Exorcise and Thraben Charm to deal with problematic cards or situations.

This deck revolves around aggressive gameplay with a focus on using creatures and burn spells to quickly deplete the opponent's life total. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional consistency and flexibility. Cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Amped Raptor serve as powerful threats, while Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge offer direct damage potential. Thoughtseize and Static Prison help disrupt the opponent's game plan, allowing for a quicker victory. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and burn spells to secure a fast win.
